$comment: Packages from the kitr package map that are not built yet. Remove an entry when its package ships a kitr block (the site also hides it automatically). status: building (in progress now), next (scheduled for the release after this one), later (roadmap only).

packages.name: local-db
packages.summary: A real database inside the app, on every platform, with one schema shared with the server.

packages.name: payments
packages.summary: Take payments and subscriptions, and check what each user has paid for, including in-app purchases.

packages.name: better-auth
packages.summary: Run kitr sign-in, sessions and permissions on Better Auth instead of writing your own.

packages.name: ai
packages.summary: Stream answers from AI models into your pages, with chat state kept alongside the rest of your data.

packages.name: push
packages.summary: Send push notifications from your server to phones and browsers, even when the app is closed.

packages.name: sync
packages.summary: Keep local data in step with the server automatically, so the app works the same online and offline.

packages.name: search
packages.summary: Add fast, typo-tolerant search over your data, with the index defined next to your models.
